description: Source code implementing the Visibility class for managing visibility patterns, checking item visibility, and converting visibility to/from values in a build system.

classes.name: Visibility
classes.description: Class managing visibility patterns, visibility checks, and conversions to/from values.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets visibility patterns from a list value, verifying type and parsing each pattern.

methods.name: SetPublic
methods.description: Sets visibility to public (all can see).

methods.name: SetPrivate
methods.description: Sets visibility to private (only within current directory).

methods.name: CanSeeMe
methods.description: Checks if a given label can see this visibility.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Returns a string description of the visibility patterns, optionally with brackets and indentation.

methods.name: AsValue
methods.description: Converts visibility patterns to a base::Value list.

methods.name: CheckItemVisibility
methods.description: Static method to verify if one item can see another based on visibility.

methods.name: FillItemVisibility
methods.description: Static method to set an item's visibility based on scope values, defaulting to public.
